title: 第23章 赌约第24章 真正的剑法
content_zh:
“柳家主，乘风兄，恭喜啊，此战之后，你们柳家，可就有两名万象殿弟子了！”
柳家所在之处，数名身穿华丽长袍的男子，缓步来到柳方志和柳乘风身旁。
“是啊，柳家主，用不了多久，这天水城，就只有你们柳家了！”
“恭喜恭喜！
乘风兄，听说你儿子柳狂尚未婚配，我膝下正有一女，不如就让他们结成连理，你看如何？”
其他几人纷纷笑着，他们都是天水城外各大势力的首领，对形势都极为了解。
在他们看来，柳狂和秦浩这一战，根本没有可比性，秦浩必败！
如此一来，便只有陈运天、刘逍和柳狂三人，无论柳狂排名第几，必然拜入万象殿。
柳家势大已成定局，此时不交好柳家，将来恐怕更没机会！
“哈哈哈，诸位，多谢了！
快快请坐！”
柳方志朗声大笑，十分得意。
柳乘风则淡笑道：“诸位，婚配之事暂且不提，狂儿如今醉心修炼，没有成家的想法。”
“能理解能理解，乘风兄，柳狂如此刻苦努力，真不愧是少年英才。”
“诸位，不如咱们打个赌如何？就赌柳狂十个呼吸时间，便可击败那废物秦浩，至于赌资，柳狂若在十息内，成功击败秦浩，我便将我天水城南门口的十家店铺，交给乘风兄！”
“此举正合我意，我赌五息时间，我北门的五家门店，也交给柳家主和乘风兄！”
……
几人纷纷开口，一脸恭维之色。
柳方志和柳乘风无语，这哪里是打赌，分明是想给他们送银子，不过，瞌睡来了有人送枕头，两人自然乐意。
彼此相视一笑，也不说话。

“秦浩终于要完蛋了！
这个废物，居然还想和我柳家作对！”
另一边，柳若杰满脸兴奋，急不可耐道：“姐，秦浩这废物肯定挡不住柳狂这一刀，真是期待啊，到时候柳狂废掉秦浩，折磨秦浩的时候，我也要去割两刀！”
“否则，难解我心头之恨！”
柳若杰咬牙切齿，又兴奋无比。
柳若雪淡淡点头，不屑道：“一个废物罢了，你想怎么折磨便怎么折磨。”
“只要有我在，即便秦家家主秦云天翻脸，也掀不起波浪！”
“倒是柳狂，刀法精进不少，从他这一刀看，柳狂的《狂烈刀法》应该是修炼到大成之境了，如此实力，进入万象殿没什么问题。”
“我已经在万象殿站稳脚跟，今日，柳狂若拜入万象殿，假以时日，我柳家必将辉煌兴盛，成为天水城独一无二的霸主！”
整个演武场，俱是议论纷纷。
所有人都认为，只要柳狂这一刀落下，这一战也就随之结束！
然而……
就在此时！
“七星步！”
content_en:
"Master Liu, Brother Chengfeng, congratulations. After this battle, your Liu family will have two disciples of Wanxiang Hall!"
Where the Liu family was, several men wearing gorgeous robes slowly came to Liu Fangzhi and Liu Chengfeng.
"Yes, Master Liu, it won't be long before your Liu family is the only one left in Tianshui City!"
"Congratulations!
Brother Chengfeng, I heard that your son Liu Kuang is not yet married, and I have a daughter at my knees. Why not let them get married? What do you think? "
Several other people laughed. They were all leaders of the major forces outside Tianshui City, and they all understood the situation very well.
In their opinion, there is no comparison between Liu Kuang and Qin Hao in this battle. Qin Hao will definitely lose!
In this way, there are only three people, Chen Yuntian, Liu Xiao and Liu Kuang. No matter where Liu Kuang ranks, he will definitely be admitted to the Hall of Vientiane.
It’s a foregone conclusion that the Liu family will be powerful. If we don’t make good friends with the Liu family now, I’m afraid there will be no chance in the future!
"Hahaha, everyone, thank you very much!
Please take a seat! "
Liu Fangzhi laughed loudly and was very proud.
Liu Chengfeng smiled lightly and said: "Everyone, let's not talk about marriage for now. Kuang'er is currently obsessed with practicing and has no idea of starting a family."
"I understand, I understand, brother Chengfeng, Liu Kuang works so hard, he is truly a young talent."
"Everyone, how about we make a bet? Just bet that Liu Kuang can defeat that good-for-nothing Qin Hao within ten breaths. As for the money, if Liu Kuang succeeds in defeating Qin Hao within ten breaths, I will hand over the ten shops at the south gate of Tianshui City to Brother Chengfeng!"
"This move is exactly what I want. I bet in five breaths of time, my five stores in the north gate will also be handed over to Patriarch Liu and Brother Chengfeng!"
…
Several people spoke one after another with compliments on their faces.
Liu Fangzhi and Liu Chengfeng were speechless. This was not a bet. They clearly wanted to give them money. However, they were naturally happy to be given pillows when they fell asleep.
They looked at each other and smiled, but didn't speak.
"Qin Hao is finally finished!
This loser actually wants to go against my Liu family! "
On the other side, Liu Ruojie's face was full of excitement and he said impatiently: "Sister, Qin Hao, this loser, will definitely not be able to stop Liu Kuang's strike. I'm really looking forward to it. When Liu Kuang cripples Qin Hao and tortures Qin Hao, I'm going to cut him twice!"
"Otherwise, it will be difficult to understand the hatred in my heart!"
Liu Ruojie gritted his teeth and was extremely excited.
Liu Ruoxue nodded lightly and said disdainfully: "It's just a waste. You can torture him however you want."
"As long as I'm here, even if Qin Yuntian, the head of the Qin family, turns against him, it won't make waves!"
"Liu Kuang, on the other hand, has improved a lot in his sword skills. Judging from his sword attack, Liu Kuang's "Crazy Sword Technique" should have been practiced to a great level. With such strength, there is no problem in entering the Wanxiang Palace."
"I have established a firm foothold in the Wanxiang Palace. Today, Liu Kuangruo joins the Wanxiang Palace. In time, my Liu family will surely flourish and become the unique overlord of Tianshui City!"
The entire martial arts arena was full of discussions.
Everyone thought that as long as Liu Kuang's sword fell, this battle would be over!
However...
Right now!
"Seven Star Steps!"
